caption: The drawing depicts a vertically oriented, ornamental metallic object consisting of several distinct segments stacked on top of each other. At the top, there is a round loop, bordered in brown with a light blue and gray stylized floral element immediately below it. Under this, a circular disc segment features intricate light blue and gray patterns suggestive of radial symmetry, again outlined in brown. Beneath the disc, a large, thick ring occupies the center portion of the composition, colored in blue-gray with alternating white segments and brown dots, bearing engraved patterns on its surface. Further down, there is a curving, S-shaped form resembling a stylized scroll, adorned with similar blue-gray, brown, and white engravings and patterns. At the bottom-most part, the object terminates in a geometric, brown, and silver-colored segment with an embedded, pale blue circular detail. The object is centered on a plain, off-white background, and the signature “HAIRY MANN WADELL” is written in small text at the bottom right.
title: Spanish Spade Bit
